claim: PutRecord is limited to 1000 TPS per shard. Each shard supports writes of up to 1,000 records per second, up to a maximum data write total of 10MiB per second. Kinesis is designed to handle intermittent large records (1-10MiB in size) using burst capacity.
question: What are the PutRecord limits per shard?

qualifiers.condition: the 10MiB per second applies to intermittent large records using burst capacity
